result.topic_en: Conditions, expressed through the signs of three sines, for the solvability of the Pothenot (resection) problem, i.e. for where the two auxiliary circles intersect relative to the main circle; a sign table follows, then the start of an elementary construction for the Pothenot problem.

items.english: If values of B, C are given that do not satisfy these conditions, or one of them, then it is certain that this problem implies a physical impossibility.

items.quote:
Umgekehrt, genügen die aufgegebenen Werthe den Bedingungen
so ist die Aufgabe möglich
items.english: Conversely, if the given values satisfy the conditions, the problem is possible.

items.quote:

dass der Durchschnitt nur ausserhalb liegen kann
items.english: In a similar way it is proved for the signs − − + that the intersection can only lie outside.
